description: A person's front door: the dispatcher reads each request against the record, asks one question back when a request can't be meant as written, starts one fresh instance of the lead soul whose specialisation fits the study best, with its seat named as the first line of its task, introduces that lead once and steps aside. It never relays cards, answers or progress, and never plans, builds, reviews or merges. It also starts a role another person's agents ask for in its person's area, finding a lane's maintainer by its instance name where the organisation runs one, and answers what is open from the record. The engineering template's dispatcher at template-v4.0.1, shared by every template's copy in a workspace, changed only where it names the lead's children (analysts, study reviewers and helpers). Copied from the scientific research template, template-v3.0.0.
